Viva on experiments, activities and project

Physics, Class XII, Part I and II (NCERT)
Laboratory Manual of Physics for Class XII (NCERT)

chapters.name: Electric Charges and Fields
topics: Electric charges; conservation of charge
Coulomb's law; forces between multiple charges; superposition principle and continuous charge distribution
Electric field due to a point charge; field lines
Electric dipole; field due to a dipole; torque on a dipole in a uniform field
Electric flux; Gauss's theorem and its applications (infinitely long straight wire, infinite plane sheet, thin spherical shell)

chapters.name: Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance
topics: Electric potential and potential difference; potential due to a point charge, a dipole and a system of charges
Equipotential surfaces; potential energy of a system of two point charges and of a dipole in an electrostatic field
Conductors and insulators; free and bound charges inside a conductor
Dielectrics and electric polarisation
Capacitors and capacitance; series and parallel combination
Parallel plate capacitor with and without dielectric; energy stored in a capacitor
notes: Energy stored in a capacitor: formulae only, no derivation

chapters.name: Current Electricity
topics: Electric current; drift velocity, mobility and their relation with current
Ohm's law; V-I characteristics (linear and non-linear)
Electrical energy and power; resistivity and conductivity; temperature dependence of resistance
Internal resistance, potential difference and emf of a cell
Combination of cells in series and parallel
Kirchhoff's rules; Wheatstone bridge

units.name: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism; Electromagnetic Induction and Alternating Currents

chapters.name: Moving Charges and Magnetism
topics: Magnetic field; Oersted's experiment
Biot-Savart law and its application to a circular loop
Ampere's law and its application to an infinitely long straight wire; straight solenoid (qualitative)
Force on a moving charge in uniform magnetic and electric fields
Force on a current-carrying conductor; force between two parallel conductors; definition of ampere
Torque on a current loop; current loop as a magnetic dipole and its dipole moment
Moving coil galvanometer: current sensitivity, conversion to ammeter and voltmeter

chapters.name: Magnetism and Matter
topics: Bar magnet; bar magnet as an equivalent solenoid
Field of a magnetic dipole along and perpendicular to its axis
Torque on a magnetic dipole in a uniform field; field lines
Para-, dia- and ferromagnetic substances; magnetisation; effect of temperature
notes: Equivalent solenoid, dipole field and torque: qualitative treatment only

chapters.name: Electromagnetic Induction
topics: Electromagnetic induction; Faraday's laws; induced emf and current
Lenz's law
Self and mutual induction

chapters.name: Alternating Current
topics: Peak and RMS value of alternating current/voltage
Reactance and impedance
LCR series circuit (phasors only); resonance
Power in AC circuits; power factor; wattless current
AC generator; transformer

chapters.name: Electromagnetic Waves
topics: Displacement current (basic idea)
Electromagnetic waves, their characteristics and transverse nature
Electromagnetic spectrum and elementary uses of each band

chapters.name: Ray Optics and Optical Instruments
topics: Reflection; spherical mirrors; mirror formula
Refraction; total internal reflection and optical fibres
Refraction at spherical surfaces; lenses; thin lens formula; lens maker's formula
Magnification; power of a lens; combination of thin lenses in contact
Refraction through a prism
Microscopes and astronomical telescopes (reflecting and refracting) and their magnifying powers

chapters.name: Wave Optics
topics: Wavefront and Huygens' principle; reflection and refraction of plane waves using wavefronts
Proof of the laws of reflection and refraction using Huygens' principle
Interference; Young's double slit experiment; fringe width
Coherent sources and sustained interference
Diffraction due to a single slit; width of central maximum
notes: Fringe width: final expression only, no derivation

units.name: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter; Atoms and Nuclei

chapters.name: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
topics: Dual nature of radiation; photoelectric effect; Hertz and Lenard's observations
Einstein's photoelectric equation: particle nature of light
Experimental study of the photoelectric effect
Matter waves; de Broglie relation

chapters.name: Atoms
topics: Alpha-particle scattering experiment; Rutherford's model
Bohr model of the hydrogen atom: radius, velocity and energy of the electron in the nth orbit
Hydrogen line spectra
notes: Hydrogen line spectra: qualitative treatment only

chapters.name: Nuclei
topics: Composition and size of the nucleus; nuclear force
Mass-energy relation, mass defect
Binding energy per nucleon and its variation with mass number
Nuclear fission and fusion

chapters.name: Semiconductor Electronics: Materials, Devices and Simple Circuits
topics: Energy bands in conductors, semiconductors and insulators
Intrinsic and extrinsic semiconductors: p and n type; p-n junction
Semiconductor diode: I-V characteristics in forward and reverse bias
Junction diode as a rectifier
